settings.title: SHUDDHI
settings.caption: Purification — the sacred beginning
settings.sutra_body_text: Shuddhi is the Ayurvedic principle of purification — removing what no longer serves so the skin can return to its natural luminosity. This two-step ritual uses Rosa Damascena and botanical actives to cleanse deeply while preserving the skin's essential moisture intelligence.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: In classical Ayurveda, no healing begins without Shuddhi. Cleansing is not merely physical — it is the ritual of presence, the act of returning to oneself before the day begins.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Botanical cream cleanser. Removes impurities, preserves moisture barrier. Rosa Damascena + Aloe + Licorice root.
settings.sutra_instruction1: Massage onto damp skin in slow, circular motions for 30–60 seconds. Rinse with lukewarm water. Pat dry gently.
settings.sutra_why1: The ritual of cleansing is not removal — it is return. Begin here.
settings.sutra_benefit2: pH-restoring botanical mist. Tightens pores, primes skin for everything that follows. Pure Rosa Damascena.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Hold 20cm from face. Mist 2–3 times. Allow to absorb fully — approximately 20 seconds. Do not wipe.
settings.sutra_why2: Rose water restores the skin's pH from alkaline (post-cleanse) to slightly acidic — the state in which all actives absorb best.

settings.title: TEJAS
settings.caption: Inner radiance — the fire of transformation
settings.sutra_pill3: ✦ All skin types, especially dull or uneven
settings.sutra_body_text: Tejas is the Ayurvedic concept of luminosity — the inner fire that radiates outward as glowing, even-toned skin. This saffron duo combines the classical Kumkumadi serum with the triple-hyaluronic moisturizer to deliver both deep brightening and all-day radiance.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: The Charaka Samhita describes Tejas as the subtle essence of Pitta — the light of intelligence made visible. Kashmir saffron is one of the few botanicals Ayurvedic texts specifically associate with Tejas restoration.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Classical Kumkumadi Tailam. Sixteen sacred botanicals. Kashmir saffron, sandalwood, blue lotus, triphala. Seven nights to visible radiance.
settings.sutra_instruction1: After cleansing and toning, dispense 3–4 drops into your palm. Press — do not rub — into skin from centre outward, then upward from jaw to brow. Allow 60 seconds to fully absorb.
settings.sutra_why1: Oil-based actives penetrate the lipid bilayer most effectively when applied to slightly damp, pH-balanced skin. The 60 seconds is not patience — it is absorption.
settings.sutra_benefit2: Triple hyaluronic acid (3 molecular weights) + ceramide complex + Kashmir saffron. Seals in the serum actives. 12-hour hydration.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Pearl-sized amount warmed between palms. Press gently into face and neck with upward strokes from jaw to hairline. Follow with SPF in the morning.
settings.sutra_why2: The moisturizer creates the occlusive seal that holds the serum actives in place and drives them deeper during the skin's overnight repair cycle.

settings.title: SOUNDARYA
settings.caption: True beauty — radiance from within
settings.sutra_pill3: ✦ All skin types, especially combination and oily
settings.sutra_body_text: Soundarya is the Sanskrit word for beauty in its most complete sense — not surface beauty, but the radiance that comes from skin in perfect balance. This set unites the weekly purifying ritual with the daily brightening serum, building the cumulative luminosity that Ayurvedic tradition calls the mark of true health.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: In Ayurvedic bridal preparation, turmeric and saffron were applied together for forty days before the wedding — Soundarya as a practice, not a product. This set revives that tradition for modern skin.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Purifying French pink clay + kaolin. Turmeric, sandalwood, rose. Clears congestion, brightens tone, calms inflammation. 1–2x weekly.
settings.sutra_instruction1: Apply an even layer to clean, dry skin avoiding the eye area. Leave for 10–15 minutes until the clay begins to tighten. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. Follow immediately with your serum.
settings.sutra_why1: The clay draws out impurities and excess sebum while turmeric's curcumin inhibits melanin synthesis. The weekly reset your daily serum builds on.
settings.sutra_benefit2: Classical Kumkumadi Tailam. Kashmir saffron, blue lotus, triphala, sandalwood. Brightens, unifies tone, reduces hyperpigmentation nightly.
settings.sutra_instruction2: After toning, press 3–4 drops into clean skin using upward motions. Allow 60 seconds to absorb fully before moisturizer. Use every evening.
settings.sutra_why2: The mask clears the pathway. The serum does the brightening work nightly. Together they address dullness at two biological levels simultaneously.

settings.title: CHIRAYU
settings.caption: Long life — eternal vitality
settings.sutra_pill3: ✦ Mature, sensitive, dry or retinol-intolerant skin
settings.sutra_body_text: Chirayu is the Ayurvedic principle of longevity — living well and looking it. This anti-ageing duo pairs the retinol-alternative serum with the triple-ceramide moisturizer for a nightly ritual that firms, smooths and repairs without irritation. For every woman who has been let down by retinol.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: Bakuchi seed has been used in Ayurvedic medicine as a Rasayana — a rejuvenating tonic — for over 3,000 years. The Ashtanga Hridayam specifically prescribes it for Vata-related skin ageing: dryness, loss of elasticity, fine lines.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Ayurvedic retinol alternative. Bakuchiol + Ashwagandha + Squalane. Clinically proven to reduce fine lines and improve firmness without irritation or photosensitivity.
settings.sutra_instruction1: After cleansing and toning, apply 4–5 drops to face and neck. Use upward and outward motions. Can be used nightly — no adjustment period required. Safe during pregnancy and nursing.
settings.sutra_why1: Bakuchiol activates the same retinoid receptors as retinol but without retinoic acid — meaning all the anti-ageing action with none of the peeling, redness or sun sensitivity.
settings.sutra_benefit2: Triple hyaluronic acid + ceramide complex NP/AP/EOP + Kashmir saffron. Rebuilds barrier, seals in bakuchiol actives, plumps fine lines overnight.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Apply pearl-sized amount after serum has absorbed. Warm between palms and press into face and neck. For extra nourishment, apply slightly heavier at night than in the morning.
settings.sutra_why2: The ceramide complex mirrors your skin's natural barrier ratio, actively rebuilding what ageing and environment have depleted — while the hyaluronic acid plumps from within.

settings.title: DINACHARYA
settings.caption: Daily practice — the art of beginning
settings.sutra_body_text: Dinacharya is the Ayurvedic morning code — the daily practice that determines how your skin holds for the rest of the day. Three steps, four minutes. Rose cleanses and preserves. Rose water primes and pH-balances. Saffron illuminates and brightens. The foundation everything else builds on.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: Ashtanga Hridayam opens with the Dinacharya chapter — daily practice — before all other prescriptions. The morning ritual is not preparation for the day. It is the day. How you begin determines everything that follows.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Botanical cream cleanser. Rosa Damascena + Aloe + Licorice root + Ceramide complex. Cleanses without stripping. Skin feels balanced, never tight.
settings.sutra_instruction1: Massage onto damp skin for 30–60 seconds in circular upward motions. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. The skin should feel clean, soft and hydrated — never squeaky.
settings.sutra_why1: Morning cleansing removes the metabolic waste your skin produced overnight, preparing a clean canvas for the actives that follow. Never skip this step.
settings.sutra_benefit2: Pure Rosa Damascena Pushkar rose water. Restores pH, tightens pores, boosts absorption of everything that follows by up to 40%.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Mist 2–3 times from 20cm. Allow 20 seconds to absorb fully. Apply your serum while skin is still slightly damp — this is the absorption window.
settings.sutra_why2: Cleansing raises skin pH to 6.5–7. The serum works at pH 4.5–5.5. Rose water restores that pH balance in 20 seconds, making the serum significantly more effective.
settings.sutra_benefit3: Classical Kumkumadi Tailam. Kashmir saffron, sandalwood, blue lotus, manjistha, triphala. Brightens, unifies tone, addresses hyperpigmentation daily.
settings.sutra_instruction3: 3–4 drops pressed into skin from centre outward using upward motions. Allow 60 seconds. Follow with SPF — oil-based serums increase photosensitivity in direct sunlight.
settings.sutra_why3: The saffron actives work continuously throughout the day, addressing uneven tone at the cellular level while the oil base provides all-day barrier nourishment.

settings.title: SWAPNA
settings.caption: Dream — the restorative night
settings.sutra_pill3: All skin types, especially mature or stressed skin
settings.sutra_body_text: Swapna is the Ayurvedic name for the dream state — the sacred hours when the body repairs what the day has taken. This three-step nighttime ritual works with the skin's natural nocturnal cycle: cleansing away the day completely, applying the firming bakuchiol serum, then sealing with the triple-ceramide moisturizer.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: Ayurvedic texts describe the three hours after midnight as the peak of Vata — the time of renewal and cellular restoration. The Swapna ritual is designed to support this natural repair cycle with botanicals prescribed in classical medicine for night-time skin restoration.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Removes the day completely — makeup, SPF, pollution, oxidative stress. Botanical cream formula. The complete reset your skin needs before repair can begin.
settings.sutra_instruction1: For evening cleansing, take a slightly larger amount and massage for 60–90 seconds. Spend extra time on areas where SPF and makeup accumulate — around the nose, hairline, and jawline.
settings.sutra_why1: Actives applied to a skin that still carries SPF, pollution particles or oxidative debris are working against resistance. A thorough cleanse is the most underrated anti-ageing step.
settings.sutra_benefit2: Natural Ayurvedic retinol alternative. Firms, smooths fine lines, improves elasticity. No irritation, no sun sensitivity. Works while you sleep.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Apply 4–5 drops to face, neck and décolletage after toning. Use upward and outward motions. Can be used every night without adjustment period. Allow 60 seconds before moisturizer.
settings.sutra_why2: The skin's repair cycle peaks between 11pm and 4am. Bakuchiol applied before this window is present in the skin precisely when collagen synthesis and cell renewal are at their highest.
settings.sutra_benefit3: Triiple butter + Kashmir saffron. Creates the occlusive seal that holds bakuchiol in place through the night's repair cycle.
settings.sutra_instruction3: Pearl-sized amount warmed in palms. Press into face and neck — slightly more generously at night than morning. Your skin will absorb more than it appears to take.
settings.sutra_why3: The ceramide complex actively repairs barrier function overnight. By morning, the skin holds hydration more efficiently — and the bakuchiol has had six hours of uninterrupted work.

settings.title: ABHYANGA
settings.caption: Sacred anointing — Sunday ceremony
settings.sutra_pill3: ✦ All skin types, especially oily, acne-prone or congested
settings.sutra_body_text: Abhyanga — sacred self-anointing — is described in the Ashtanga Hridayam as a weekly practice for skin, mind and spirit. This Sunday ritual takes 20 minutes and delivers results that daily skincare cannot: a deep clay purification, the reset of congestion and dullness, followed by the brightening serum to capitalise on the freshly cleared skin.
settings.sutra_ayurveda_text: The Ashtanga Hridayam prescribes Abhyanga weekly: "The body of one who uses oil massage regularly does not become affected much even if subjected to injury. His skin becomes smooth, strong and charmed." — Ashtanga Hridayam 2.8–9.
settings.sutra_benefit1: Double-cleanse to fully prepare skin before the mask. Remove all traces of SPF, makeup and sebum so the clay can work on clean skin only.
settings.sutra_instruction1: For the Abhyanga ritual, double-cleanse: first pass removes surface impurities, second pass prepares a truly clean base. The second cleanse will feel different — that's the difference.
settings.sutra_why1: Clay masks perform significantly better on thoroughly cleansed skin. Residual SPF and sebum create a barrier that prevents the kaolin and bentonite from drawing directly from the pores.
settings.sutra_benefit2: French pink clay + kaolin + bentonite. Turmeric curcumin, sandalwood, rose. Draws out congestion, brightens tone, calms inflammation. The weekly reset.
settings.sutra_instruction2: Apply an even layer to clean, dry skin avoiding the eye area. Leave 10–15 minutes. While the clay works, this is your meditation — the ritual of waiting is part of the ceremony. Rinse with warm water.
settings.sutra_why2: The triple-clay complex (French pink + kaolin + bentonite) addresses three types of congestion simultaneously: surface impurities, sebum congestion and oxidative buildup. The glow lasts 3–4 days.
settings.sutra_benefit3: Applied immediately after the mask, saffron actives penetrate freshly cleared pores at maximum depth. The weekly dose of Kumkumadi that accelerates your nightly results.
settings.sutra_instruction3: Apply the serum immediately after rinsing the mask — within 2 minutes. The pores are open, the skin is clear and the saffron actives will penetrate at their deepest. 3–4 drops, pressed in upward motions.
settings.sutra_why3: Post-mask skin is the highest-absorption moment in your entire week. The serum you apply in this window goes deeper than any other application. This is the Abhyanga advantage.
